scope: Packaging of already completed independent public review; one portability/raw-hash replay of engineering arithmetic only.

minimal_changes: Add argparse and two required positional arguments: repo_root and output.
Replace the two reviewer-specific absolute paths with resolved positional paths.
Hash raw file bytes rather than replacing CRLF with LF before SHA-256.
engineering_checker.unchanged: All fixture arithmetic, trace replay, identity/count checks, thresholds, guard checks, resource arithmetic, receipt schema and output values.
engineering_checker.input_revision_requirement: Use a checkout/export of the reviewed commit. A later review branch may intentionally change AGENT_HANDOFF.md, which is bound by the reviewed delivery manifest.

hash_mode_provenance.effect: No observed difference: all manifest files in the reviewed export already use LF; all 1,055 raw-byte hashes match.

science_artifacts: Copied byte-for-byte under requested filenames; no additional science replay was run during packaging.
limits: The original receipts retain their original scopes and limitations.
Public engineering replay evaluates saved parameter trajectories and deterministic engineering fixture relationships; it is not a new fit.
This file records package provenance, not independent attestation of private archive bytes.
